items.title: Marble theme
items.description: Tokens, materials, motion and base styles, plus the theme provider (d toggles dark mode).

theme.shadow-stone:
inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12),
    inset 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 75%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 22%, transparent),
    inset 0 -4px 6px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18), 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18),
    0 3px 6px -3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2)
theme.shadow-key:
inset 1px 2px 0 0 var(--face, transparent),
    inset 2px 3px 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 65%, transparent),
    inset -1px -2px 0 0 var(--face, transparent),
    inset -2px -3px 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 22%, transparent),
    inset 0 -7px 9px -5px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2),
    0 3px 0 0
      var(--lip, color-mix(in oklch, var(--face, var(--edge)), black 30%)),
    0 6px 12px -5px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.24)
theme.shadow-key-pressed:
inset 1px 2px 0 0 var(--face, transparent),
    inset 2px 3px 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 25%, transparent),
    inset -1px -2px 0 0 var(--face, transparent),
    inset -2px -3px 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--highlight) 7%, transparent),
    inset 0 2px 6px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2),
    0 1px 0 0
      var(--lip, color-mix(in oklch, var(--face, var(--edge)), black 30%)),
    0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14)

@utility gloss-sheen.--gloss-reflection:
linear-gradient(
    115deg,
    transparent 14%,
    color-mix(
        in oklch,
        var(--sheen) calc(50% * var(--gloss-strength, 1)),
        transparent
      )
      25%,
    color-mix(
        in oklch,
        var(--sheen) calc(12% * var(--gloss-strength, 1)),
        transparent
      )
      37%,
    transparent 42%
  )

@utility gloss.background-image:
var(--gloss-reflection),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, var(--shade) 90%, var(--bounce))

@utility key.background-image:
linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07),
    transparent 45%,
    oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1)
  )
